name: Cheesy Egg-Taco Beef Bake with Jalapeños & Cumin-Strawberry Mixed Greens (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add beef, taco seasoning, and salt to the skillet; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground beef
1 tbsp taco seasoning
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
½ avocado
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Place eggs in a medium bowl and whisk to combine. When the beef has cooled, add eggs to the skillet and stir to combine. Sprinkle skillet with cheese, then top with sliced jalapeños. Place in the oven and bake until the egg is set and cheese is bubbly, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the scrambled eggs.)
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp brown sugar
⅛ tsp cumin, ground
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Place a ⅔-cup of strawberries on a plate. Add remaining strawberries to the bowl with the dressing.

Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Cut half of the avocado lengthwise into wedges, add to the plate with the strawberries, and set aside. Medium dice remaining avocado, add to the bowl, and set aside.
Place additional eggs in the reserved bowl, along with salt and pepper, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggs and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the skillet. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, then add cheese and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: When the taco bake is done, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad. Cut or tear tortilla into pieces.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide cheesy scrambled eggs, strawberries, avocado wedges, and tortillas between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide taco bake and salad between plates. Enjoy!
